usedFor: Shopify records your orders, and Copy.ai writes from them when “Order Paid” runs “Start a Workflow Run”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Start a Workflow Run” in Copy.ai
bestTemplate.why: A paid order starts a Copy.ai workflow, so follow-up copy is drafted without anyone opening the order.

watchOut: Anything Copy.ai writes for a customer should wait for your approval before it goes out.
